name: reset_state
goal: Synchronous reset empties the FIFO: count 0, empty 1, dout 0, overflow and underflow 0.
stimulus: test_reset_state: after reset the FIFO is empty, count 0, dout 0, no flags
check: every output compared with the cycle-accurate golden model on every clock (scoreboard)

name: fifo_order_wraparound
goal: Data is read out in the order it was written, including across pointer wraparound.
stimulus: test_wraparound_order: data leaves in write order across pointer wraparound
check: every output compared with the cycle-accurate golden model on every clock (scoreboard)

name: full_empty_flags
goal: full is 1 exactly when DEPTH entries are stored; empty is 1 exactly when none are.
stimulus: test_full_flag: full asserts exactly when DEPTH entries are stored; test_empty_flag: empty asserts exactly when the last entry is read
check: every output compared with the cycle-accurate golden model on every clock (scoreboard)

name: overflow_write_when_full
goal: A write when full with no read is ignored and pulses overflow for one cycle.
stimulus: test_overflow: a write when full (no read) is ignored and flags overflow
check: every output compared with the cycle-accurate golden model on every clock (scoreboard)

name: underflow_read_when_empty
goal: A read when empty is ignored, pulses underflow for one cycle, and dout holds its value.
stimulus: test_underflow: a read when empty is ignored, flags underflow, dout holds
check: every output compared with the cycle-accurate golden model on every clock (scoreboard)

name: read_write_when_full
goal: Read and write in the same cycle when full: the oldest word is read, the new word is stored, count stays DEPTH.
stimulus: test_full_simultaneous_rw: read + write when full reads the oldest, stores the new word
check: every output compared with the cycle-accurate golden model on every clock (scoreboard)

name: read_write_when_empty
goal: Read and write in the same cycle when empty: the word is stored, the read is ignored, underflow pulses.
stimulus: test_empty_simultaneous_rw: read + write when empty stores the word and flags underflow
check: every output compared with the cycle-accurate golden model on every clock (scoreboard)

name: almost_full_threshold
goal: almost_full is 1 exactly when count >= AF_THRESH.
stimulus: test_almost_full: almost_full is high exactly when count >= AF_THRESH
check: every output compared with the cycle-accurate golden model on every clock (scoreboard)

name: count_tracks_occupancy
goal: count equals the number of stored entries after every cycle.
stimulus: test_full_flag: full asserts exactly when DEPTH entries are stored
check: every output compared with the cycle-accurate golden model on every clock (scoreboard)

name: no_overflow_read_write_when_full
goal: A write when full together with a read in the same cycle is accepted: overflow stays 0.
stimulus: test_full_simultaneous_rw: read + write when full reads the oldest, stores the new word
check: every output compared with the cycle-accurate golden model on every clock (scoreboard)
